_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro:
Riolaso Player {player_id}, makkalai {num_rounds} ronde IUG (Iterated Ultimatum Game).
Riasengnge ${pool} riolo riaseuwi ronde sia antara riolaso na Player {other_id}.

Proposer:
  - Makkalai pakkau: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool)
  - Iami riolo accetta → Riolaso ngasengnge $(pool - X), player lainnge ngasengnge $X
  - Iami riolo tolak → Keduanya ngasengnge $0
  - Conto: [Offer: $3]  ata  'Kuangka sengaja rieppo. [Offer: $5]'

Responder:
  - Makkalai keputusan pakkau riaseuwi [Accept] ata [Reject]
  - Conto: 'Sengaja rieppo. [Accept]'
            'Tidak adil. [Reject]'

round.begins:
--- Ronde {round_number} ri mulai! ---
Ole' {proposer_id} ri pappasang, ole' {responder_id} ri panyanggah.
round.offer: Ronde {round_number}: ole' {proposer_id} ri tawarkan $ {offer} ri ole' {responder_id} (nai $ {keep}).
round.accepted: Ole' {responder_id} ri terima! Ronde {round_number} ri untung: ole' {proposer_id} +$ {proposer_gain}, ole' {responder_id} +$ {responder_gain}. Jumlah baru: ole' 0: $ {total_0}, ole' 1: $ {total_1}.
round.rejected: Ole' {responder_id} ri tolak tawaran! Ronde {round_number} ri untung: keduanya ri +$0. Jumlah tetap: ole' 0: $ {total_0}, ole' 1: $ {total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: Tau mappiddarae parellu makkebbu pabbere na pakei bentu' [Offer: $X].
invalid_move.bad_integer: Nilai nawarengi waji' mancaji bilangang makkalepu iya makkeguna.
invalid_move.accept_or_reject: Responder harus makkalai [Accept] ata [Reject] pakkau riaseuwi.

outcome.win: Ole' {winner} ri menang dengan $ {winner_total} jumlah vs ole' {loser} ri $ {loser_total}.
outcome.draw: Draw! Duanna tau maccule'e purai napunnai ${total} total.
